note: YC S15 (Summer 2015), status Active, website heroiclabs.com matches the provider card's domain, confirming the hint. Founded ~2014 by Chris Molozian, Andrei, and Mo (Queen Mary University of London alumni); makers of Nakama (open-sourced 2017), Heroic Cloud, Hiro, and Satori. Company explicitly describes itself as bootstrapped and founder-led despite YC participation; no press of a priced seed/Series A/etc. round was found in the time available.
